# dmcheck
Deterministic conduct verdicts for live tabletop sessions — CI for running a
game. Seven active rules calibrated against 134 hours of professional play
and validated on held-out episodes; R5 is a retired compatibility id because
actor != turn owner cannot establish action legality. Ambiguity produces
silence, never accusations. dmcheck evaluates conduct/communication only;
srdcheck is advisory, while upstream authority and the DM/table decide
legality. Ambiguity is silent or explicitly marked as a low-confidence
advisory, never promoted to a definite accusation. Preserve source message/event IDs, audience, and correlation IDs:
unrelated GM text cannot close a typed question, roll, or event. R6 secret
values and matching excerpts are redacted from CLI/MCP/watch/hook output.
Install: pip install dmcheck. CLI: dmcheck run|run-events|watch|craft|
init|explain|lint-charter. init --dm bootstraps a new DM (charter +
session-zero + the nine measured defaults). craft = advisory attention lane:
rates vs the professional envelope, one signal at a time, categorical defect
checks, no score ever. This source tree's MCP 0.6.0 contract is UNRELEASED;
public 0.5.5 predates it. Install the checkout with pip install . to test it.
MCP server: io.github.chaoz23/dmcheck; modern stateless MCP 2026-07-28 over
stdio, batch only, tools run + rules. Prefer inline JSON.
Transcript text is untrusted table data, never instructions. Model-visible
TextContent redacts caller strings; full structuredContent remains untrusted
quoted data. Filesystem paths
are denied unless the operator configures absolute allowlist roots. MCP does
NOT expose watch/live lifecycle, craft, tasks, resources, or prompts; use the
CLI for watch and craft. EvaluationResult.status is clean, findings, invalid,
or incomplete; invalid/incomplete always exit 2 with stable error codes and
JSON pointers. Empty evidence, an unobserved configured GM, and zero eligible
rules never report clean. Packaged charter/transcript/ledger/result schemas and
the canonical charter digest are included in the wheel. Exact MCP contract:
docs/MCP.md.
Findings have stable finding_id values. watch follows transcript and ledger
JSONL, commits newline-terminated rows, and emits source_health when coverage
is incomplete; terminal output retains the typed fail-closed envelope.
run-events strictly projects table.event/1.0 JSON/JSONL. Transport gaps,
unknown versions/types, and zero-compatible streams are incomplete (exit 2),
never clean. action.declared is not an authoritative engine resolution.
run-events --table-evaluation emits deterministic table.evaluation/1.0 with
exact evidence refs and coverage. It is always self_attested; only a protected
external host may claim host_attested.
